now.summary: A weekly Lab Night, open Lab Notes, a studio on Discord, three values.

items.title: Open the studio
items.text: More of the work happens in the open. Members’ experiments, shown on this site and in the Discord, each at its stage: designed, built, measured, iterated. Every member’s journey is itself an experiment, shared so others can learn from it.

items.title: From experiment to something real
items.text: We help members take an experiment all the way: from a Thursday demo to something that stands on its own. Not a unicorn. A millicorn: small, self-funded, built with AI, solving a problem close to home.

horizon.title: Eight billion
horizon.text: Eight billion people are heading toward a world where the distance from idea to action is zero, and most of us were never taught how to design our lives for it. The Collective is a place to learn it together, one experiment at a time, and to pass it on.
